title: Crossing the Validation Crisis: Cross-Validation Reduces Benchmarking Variance Surprisingly Well
abstract: arXiv:2606.12552v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern machine learning progresses through empirical work, benchmarking new methods to evaluate relative performance. However, the statistical variability inherent in evaluation, exacerbated by the stochastic nature of many algorithms, often makes performance estimation unreliable with the limited test samples available. The result is a validation crisis, in which genuine advances are difficult to discern. Here, we show that doing more cross-validation markedly improves confidence when evaluating and comparing learning algorithm performances. We introduce the concept of sample gain, which quantifies the virtual data augmentation achieved by using multiple cross-validation splits to reduce benchmarking variance. translated_title: 跨越验证危机：交叉验证出人意料地有效降低基准测试方差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.12552v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代机器学习的进步依赖于实证研究，即通过对新方法进行基准测试来评估相对性能。然而，评估中固有的统计变异性，加之许多算法的随机性，常常使得在有限的测试样本下性能估计不可靠。其结果便是一场验证危机，真正的进步难以辨别。在这项工作中，我们证明进行更多的交叉验证能够显著提高评估和比较学习算法性能时的置信度。我们引入了“样本增益”的概念，用以量化通过使用多个交叉验证划分来降低基准测试方差所实现的虚拟数据增强效果。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集（组织病理学扫描和NLP微调）上的实验表明，多次划分能够大幅提高性能估计的可靠性和稳定性，且收益呈递减趋势。
tldr: 本文提出“样本增益”概念，证明采用多个交叉验证划分可通过虚拟数据增强效应显著降低基准测试方差，从而大幅提升性能评估的可靠性与稳定性，有效缓解机器学习领域的验证危机。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "sample gain" and demonstrates that using multiple cross-validation splits, through a virtual data augmentation effect, substantially reduces benchmarking variance and improves the reliability and stability of performance estimates, thereby alleviating the validation crisis in machine learning.
